structure.unit: Department for Aging and Rehabilitative Services
Virginia Public Guardian and Conservator Program

law.catch_line: Powers and duties of the Department with respect to guardian training
law.text: The Department shall develop and provide training for guardians pursuant to § 64.2-2019 that shall include training on the responsibilities and duties of guardians, how to complete annual guardianship reports, how to involve and encourage participation of incapacitated adults in decisions made by such guardians, medical advocacy, and decision-making on behalf of other persons.
